title: Palo Alto PAN-OS Command Injection
summary: A command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature of certain PAN-OS versions may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute code.
recommendation: Check the exact PAN-OS version and configuration against the vendor advisory. Apply the appropriate fixed release and review vendor mitigation guidance.

title: MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection
affected_versions: Multiple vulnerable releases; consult vendor advisory
summary: A SQL injection vulnerability in MOVEit Transfer may allow unauthorized access to the application's database.
recommendation: Identify MOVEit installations, check the exact affected versions, apply vendor patches and review available indicators of compromise.

title: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution
summary: Log4Shell is a vulnerability in Apache Log4j that may allow remote code execution under vulnerable conditions.
recommendation: Identify applications using affected Log4j versions, update to an appropriate supported fixed version and follow vendor remediation guidance.

title: Citrix NetScaler Information Disclosure
affected_versions: Selected NetScaler ADC and Gateway releases
summary: An information disclosure vulnerability affecting certain NetScaler ADC and Gateway deployments may expose sensitive information.
recommendation: Check affected versions, install vendor updates and review guidance concerning session invalidation and possible compromise.

title: XZ Utils Supply Chain Backdoor
summary: Malicious code was discovered in certain XZ Utils releases. Under specific build and deployment conditions, affected systems could be exposed to serious security risks.
recommendation: Check installed XZ Utils versions and distribution advisories. Remove affected packages and use trusted fixed versions.
